What is Skizophonic?

The
slowest
band
in
history
emerged
in
late
2003
between
Benicàssim
and
Castellón,
Spain,
crafting
an
alternative
rock
sound
shaped
by
classic
rock
influences.

However,
in
their
restless
pursuit
of
eclectic
ideas,
the
members
of
Skizophonic
gravitated
toward
garage,
soul,
and
especially
acid
sounds,
blending
a
mod
spirit
with
subtle
electronic
touches.

Today,
they
survive
as
soldiers
of
fortune.
If
you
have
good
taste
and
a
discerning
ear,
you
might
appreciate
them.
